confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'You will need a replacement battery; this is a standard wear part... and not a fault with the main unit itself.'

rationale: The assistant reached the likely right conclusion (battery replacement) after the customer confirmed flashing red, a full direct charge, and no blockage. However, it stated this with false certainty, explicitly ruling out the main unit, and gave no Dyson support or warranty pointer. It also never asked about the declining runtime or battery swelling/heat, and its first reply wrongly expected an amber light and focused on overheating and blockage, which was less relevant to the evidence.
